mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_events (event_type, user_id, session_id, created_at) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT event_type as eventType, COUNT(*) as count FROM user_events WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY event_type
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(user_id, session_id)) FROM user_events WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND (user_id IS NOT NULL OR session_id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) as eventDate, event_type as eventType, COUNT(*) as count FROM user_events WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')), event_type ORDER BY eventDate ASC
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_events WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND user_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) as eventDate, event_type as eventType, COUNT(*) as count FROM user_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')), event_type ORDER BY eventDate ASC

SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) as eventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(user_id, session_id)) as count FROM user_events WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND (user_id IS NOT NULL OR session_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+00:00', 'America/Vancouver')) ORDER BY eventDate ASC
SELECT user_id FROM user_events WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id HAVING MAX(created_at) < #{since}
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_events WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
